media_path.description: Absolute path of the immutable source media.

cut_path.description: Path of the rendered rough-cut media (auto-editor render mode).

edit_rule.description: The auto-editor edit rule used, verbatim (e.g. 'audio:threshold=4%'). Recorded so the cut is auditable -- see skills/core/nle-timeline-export.md.

fcpxml_path.description: Path of the auto-editor timeline export (resolve/fcpxml) carrying the exact cut decisions for the next stage.
